description: A safety-interlocked three-state motor controller with temperature monitoring.

states.name: IDLE
states.description: Motor is stopped; start is allowed only at a safe temperature.

states.name: RUNNING
states.description: Motor is energized; over-temperature must latch a fault.

states.name: FAULT
states.description: Fault is latched; start is forbidden until a safe reset.

constraints.description: In FAULT, start() must raise SafetyInterlockError and state must remain FAULT.
Any temperature above 80 must immediately latch FAULT from IDLE or RUNNING.
reset() is legal only in FAULT and only when temperature <= 80; otherwise raise SafetyInterlockError and remain FAULT.
start() is legal only in IDLE; any other state must raise InvalidTransitionError.
stop() is legal only in RUNNING; any other state must raise InvalidTransitionError.

constructor.behavior: Set temperature and start in IDLE; if initial_temperature > 80, latch FAULT immediately.

acceptance_criteria.description: MotorController() starts in IDLE at 25.0 degrees.
start() from IDLE at a safe temperature moves to RUNNING.
stop() from RUNNING moves to IDLE.
start() in FAULT raises SafetyInterlockError and state stays FAULT.
reset() in FAULT at temperature 81 raises SafetyInterlockError and state stays FAULT.
reset() in FAULT at temperature 25 moves to IDLE.
